newDifferentialBlockers: See differential-findings.json: strict C1/parser-policy and valid mixed cell foreground discrepancies remain failing, not expected-success negative controls.

unicodeScalarTable.policy: Native Term::input uses per-scalar UnicodeWidthChar, not grapheme folding.

rawUpstreamBug.delivery: Each UTF-8 byte is a separate write(Uint8Array, callback).
rawUpstreamBug.sourceEvidence: Installed _utf8Decoder constructor: for (; (n=63&this.interim[++a]) && a<4;) reconstructs stored continuation bytes using their 6-bit payload as termination condition. For E2 80 8D, stored 0x80 has zero payload and terminates reconstruction early; resumed length expects an extra continuation and drops U+200D. Direct decoder instrumentation and raw write negative controls reproduce this. Source inspection only; no private implementation patch.
rawUpstreamBug.bridgeStatus: Strict native comparison now uses public xterm.write(string, actual callback), full native width provider, and a bounded per-session scalar framer plus persistent TextDecoder. Raw bug remains explicitly tested as a negative control.

bridgePolicy.decoder: TextDecoder utf-8 fatal=false ignoreBOM=true with stream=true; only completed scalar frames are passed to it
bridgePolicy.reasonForScalarFramer: Plain WHATWG TextDecoder differs from native vte0.15 on raw C1 handling and incomplete EOF. Framer applies native replacement/C1 policy without buffering ANSI sequences. Surrogate, out-of-range, malformed continuation and EOF fixtures are compared exactly.
bridgePolicy.ack: Real string-write callback precedes consumption ACK; pending UTF8 bytes forbid first_frame and commit despite log reclamation. EOF drops incomplete scalar like native vte, then uses real flush-write callback.
bridgePolicy.limitations: Not a proof of every invalid-byte/ANSI-state interaction; native VTE parsing is stateful and this bridge does not replicate the entire VT parser.

unproven: DOM/GPU first-frame presentation (host_frame_model is not a frame)
Arbitrary ANSI/protocol equivalence or all malformed-byte interactions inside control strings
Manual visual vim/tmux validation; only automated isolated real PTY sessions
